notes.title: v 0.6 Multiplayer first public version
notes.notes:
Multiplayer available now.
There still have to be done some testing and improvements, but it generally works fine.


Vegetation system overhaul.
Some skills added.
Lots of general improvements.

notes.title: 0.57a Medium Update
notes.notes:
The shaders on nscs, some objects and dungeons have been replaced.
Evening/morning and night enviromental ambiente etc lights have been changed.
You can see much better now at night.

Side info: changed some post processing effects for these changes.

Some bug fixes.

notes.title: Small weekly update for version 0.57 - mainly qol changes
notes.notes:
Area:
Finished the living house in town for the new npcs. No more grass sticking out of the floor!
Doors can now be opened and closed using right click. They still open and close automatically.

Added seasonal slime outbreak on every thursday for some bonus experience (start area in spring).
Added as a happening so the fortune teller will tell you about this.
For this a new functionality in spawners with increased power and reward quality has beend added.

Balance:
Some attacks and skill area of effects have been increased.
Evasion is now roughly 5 times as good as before.

Lots of UI changes (some listed here):
Equipment icons have been changed. Background is now alpha only.
Aura and buff stats are now shown in the skill menu.
Made some visibility changes to the character equipment menu.
Empty slots can be distinguished now much easier. The stats for weapon damage are now easier to compare. Some minor text changes.
The choosable rewards from quests have had their background changed to the rarity color.
Made some texts easier to read when the background was too bright.

Graphics:
Drastically Lowered Color Grading.

Generel:
Some events now only trigger at day. Most events in town are affected by this change.

Fixed:
Fortune teller giving out old wisdoms when the quests were already done in the current walkthrough.
Fortune teller camera transfer.
A few smaller bugs.

Whats next:
More balancing, better shaders for skin and hair, qol changes.
Equipment and/or skills that allow moving while channeling (while grounded).
Adding skills for mage and ranger classes.
